notes: Novel capability — Contentstack Live Preview SDK integration. The attachment point is useContent, the central hook (236 callers) that all Contentstack components call via getContentByKey. Enhancing this hook to subscribe to Live Preview events from Contentstack SDK will propagate real-time content updates to every consuming component without page reload. No existing live preview code was found in the indexed files. VCs are derived from the description since ACs are empty. Contentstack.io is unreachable at test time, so VCs stop at our side of the boundary: what our code subscribes to, how it handles events, and what it renders given a known update.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptanceCriteria, so all criteria are new. I examined useContent.ts, [[...slug]].tsx, contentCard.ts, and ContentstackLink.tsx to ground the ACs in the actual architecture. Key findings: useContent is the central hook called via getContentByKey by 236+ callers; it fetches content by content type and locale and returns content data. [[...slug]].tsx uses useContent for page-level entries. ContentstackLink renders reference/link fields. ACs cover: subscription lifecycle (AC1-3, AC5), error/fallback when SDK unavailable (AC4, AC6, AC7), security/XSS (AC8), reference field updates (AC9), multi-subscriber deduplication (AC10), page-level updates (AC11), locale handling (AC12), accessibility (AC13), and rapid-update debouncing (AC14). All ACs are observable outcomes with Given/When/Then structure and contain no implementation instructions.
